intro: We have received 24 well-organized three-ring binders from Barbara Zitzewitz, daughter of late Professor Milton Shaw. Each binder has an index page, which is marked by the Volume number and lists publications and manuscripts in this binder/volume. We have scanned all 24 Volumes.
